literal: Guiding others in the right path, without deviating from virtue, a domestic life possesses greater power of endurance than those who perform penance.
translation: A domestic life that guides others in the right path and does not itself deviate from virtue possesses greater power of endurance than the penance of ascetics.
modern: பிறரை நல்வழியில் செலுத்தி, தானும் அறநெறியிலிருந்து தவறாமல் வாழ்கின்ற இல்லற வாழ்க்கை, தவம் செய்வோரின் தவ வலிமையை விடவும் சிறந்த வலிமையைக் கொண்டதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet compares the moral strength of a householder with that of an ascetic. The poet states that a domestic life (இல்வாழ்க்கை) has greater power of endurance (நோன்மை) than the penance of ascetics (நோற்பார்). This is because the householder must guide others along the path of virtue (ஆற்றின் ஒழுக்கி) while ensuring they do not slip from righteousness themselves (அறனிழுக்கா). While ascetics only endure personal hardships, a householder must support others to live virtuously while maintaining their own integrity, which requires far greater moral fortitude.
